role: The lily pad: a flat water-surface plant that stays only on still water, is skipped by boats in collision, and renders with the fixed colour 2129968.

members.name: addCollisionBoxesToList
members.note: case 111 carries the box; the boat exclusion rides the entity filter in the collide dispatch

members.name: getBlockColor
members.note: the constant 2129968 baked into the lily-pad lane; render-only: every caller is the client renderer (RenderBlocks, RenderItem, ItemRenderer, RenderGlobal's outline, the item icon and colour hooks); row recordings draw no frames (a frame replay runs it: lane/covframes' frame coverage)

members.name: getRenderColor
members.note: same constant; render-only: every caller is the client renderer (RenderBlocks, RenderItem, ItemRenderer, RenderGlobal's outline, the item icon and colour hooks); row recordings draw no frames

members.name: colorMultiplier
members.note: same constant; render-only: every caller is the client renderer (RenderBlocks, RenderItem, ItemRenderer, RenderGlobal's outline, the item icon and colour hooks); row recordings draw no frames

members.name: func_149854_a
members.note: the water-only floor test; the random tick reads canBlockStay's override instead (bush_floor_ok, id 111)

members.name: canBlockStay
members.note: y in 0..255, water below at meta 0: randomtick.c bush_floor_ok's id-111 branch, which BlockBush.updateTick's random tick reaches through randomtick_update_tick (the id fell through the dispatch until lane/longrun)

notes: Placed by feature_waterlily in swamp decoration and by the item use (itemuse.c lily_rclick, recorded in rc-animals-s1). The pad's stay check runs through the bush tick path shared with the other plants.
